text.p: Lyonnaise des Eaux chairman Jerome Monod on Thursday confirmed a forecast of a 1997 profit of more than 1.6 billion francs and said that exposure to the property market would no longer weigh on the group's accounts.
"We can all be optimistic on the outlook for Lyonnaise des Eaux and our 1997 result should exceed 1.6 billion francs," he told the annual general meeting.
The group made a 1996 profit of 1.349 billion francs.

The property market, which took a heavy toll on results of financial groups and other companies after the bottom fell out of the market at the end of the 1980s, would no longer hit Lyonnaise, which is merging with Suez, he said.
